verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents that apps can be deployed in regions worldwide, so users choose where workloads, and by extension their attached storage, run. The evidence never explicitly ties data storage (volumes or Managed Postgres) to a chosen region, and it makes no data-residency commitments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that volumes/databases are pinned to a user-selected region, data-residency or compliance guarantees, a region list or selection mechanics for storage, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can deploy apps in regions worldwide, so your users in Tokyo, São Paulo, or Amsterdam connect to the nearest server through our global Anycast network.
The Fly Machines REST API provides resources to provision and manage Fly Apps, Fly Machines, and Fly Volumes.
